lines.text: FRIGATE: Ring closing. Raiders on the bow.
lines.spoken: Ring closing. Raiders on the bow.

lines.speaker: FRIGATE
lines.text: FRIGATE: Second group off the platform. Hold them.
lines.spoken: Second group off the platform. Hold them.

lines.speaker: FRIGATE
lines.text: FRIGATE: Third group, low on the water. Two left in the ring.
lines.spoken: Third group, low on the water. Two left in the ring.

lines.speaker: FRIGATE
lines.text: FRIGATE: One gap open. Scan the water before we close the ring.
lines.spoken: One gap open. Scan the water before we close the ring.

lines.speaker: FRIGATE
lines.text: FRIGATE: No wake in the gap. Finish the sweep.
lines.spoken: No wake in the gap. Finish the sweep.

lines.speaker: FRIGATE
lines.text: FRIGATE: Ring closed. Command flight launching. Four, from both sides.
lines.spoken: Ring closed. Command flight launching. Four, from both sides.

lines.speaker: FRIGATE
lines.text: FRIGATE: Follow the outer beacons. Check the whole sea lane is in sight.
lines.spoken: Follow the outer beacons. Check the whole sea lane is in sight.

lines.speaker: FRIGATE
lines.text: FRIGATE: Western lane visible. Sweep to the eastern beacon.
lines.spoken: Western lane visible. Sweep to the eastern beacon.

lines.speaker: FRIGATE
lines.text: FRIGATE: Inspection launch crossing. Cover it until it docks.
lines.spoken: Inspection launch crossing. Cover it until it docks.

lines.speaker: FRIGATE
lines.text: FRIGATE: Inspection launch halfway across. Gap remains clear.
lines.spoken: Inspection launch halfway across. Gap remains clear.

lines.speaker: FRIGATE
lines.text: FRIGATE: No ships through. Hold the command link for the landing force.
lines.spoken: No ships through. Hold the command link for the landing force.

lines.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
lines.text: LANDING FORCE: Ring report received. Bringing our boats forward.
lines.spoken: Ring report received. Bringing our boats forward.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Under the storm. Three gates to the platform.
lines.spoken: Under the storm. Three gates to the platform.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Last gate. The deck stores are ahead.
lines.spoken: Last gate. The deck stores are ahead.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Three stores on the deck. Burn them.
lines.spoken: Three stores on the deck. Burn them.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Patrol in the storm shadow. Five, in two groups.
lines.spoken: Patrol in the storm shadow. Five, in two groups.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Scan below the cloud. The tanker is hiding behind the deck smoke.
lines.spoken: Scan below the cloud. The tanker is hiding behind the deck smoke.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Engine heat below the cloud. It is running for the coast.
lines.spoken: Engine heat below the cloud. It is running for the coast.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Tanker jet lifting off, running for the coast. Stop it.
lines.spoken: Tanker jet lifting off, running for the coast. Stop it.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Tanker's halfway to the coast. Close on it.
lines.spoken: Tanker's halfway to the coast. Close on it.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: He's almost over the city. Now!
lines.spoken: He's almost over the city. Now!

lines.speaker: FRIGATE
lines.text: FRIGATE: Deck crew aboard. Cover them clear of the burning stores.
lines.spoken: Deck crew aboard. Cover them clear of the burning stores.

lines.speaker: FRIGATE
lines.text: FRIGATE: Launch halfway clear. Deck crew accounted for.
lines.spoken: Launch halfway clear. Deck crew accounted for.

lines.speaker: FRIGATE
lines.text: FRIGATE: Tanker down. Hold while we check for other launches.
lines.spoken: Tanker down. Hold while we check for other launches.

lines.speaker: FRIGATE
lines.text: FRIGATE: No second tanker on radar. Checking the last deck returns.
lines.spoken: No second tanker on radar. Checking the last deck returns.

lines.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
lines.text: LANDING CRAFT: Beach in eighty seconds. Keep them off us.
lines.spoken: Beach in eighty seconds. Keep them off us.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Second intercept launching. Stay on the craft.
lines.spoken: Second intercept launching. Stay on the craft.

lines.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
lines.text: LANDING CRAFT: Surf line. Ramps going down.
lines.spoken: Surf line. Ramps going down.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: First intercept off the apron. Three, in two groups.
lines.spoken: First intercept off the apron. Three, in two groups.

lines.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
lines.text: LANDING CRAFT: Ramps down. Scan both exits so we can leave the sand.
lines.spoken: Ramps down. Scan both exits so we can leave the sand.

lines.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
lines.text: LANDING CRAFT: West exit clear. Check the eastern street.
lines.spoken: West exit clear. Check the eastern street.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Second wave with raiders, coming round behind. Hold the beach.
lines.spoken: Second wave with raiders, coming round behind. Hold the beach.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Beach relay is still directing fire. Cut it.
lines.spoken: Beach relay is still directing fire. Cut it.

lines.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
lines.text: LANDING CRAFT: Streets reached. Hold for both beach exits to answer.
lines.spoken: Streets reached. Hold for both beach exits to answer.

lines.speaker: LANDING CRAFT
lines.text: LANDING CRAFT: West exit answering. Waiting for the eastern squad.
lines.spoken: West exit answering. Waiting for the eastern squad.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Wing splits. Four ahead; the rest will come round behind.
lines.spoken: Wing splits. Four ahead; the rest will come round behind.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Second flight on your six! Turn!
lines.spoken: Second flight on your six! Turn!

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Signal bouncing between roofs. Scan low to narrow it down.
lines.spoken: Signal bouncing between roofs. Scan low to narrow it down.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Rooftop echoes mapped. We still need the name of the mast.
lines.spoken: Rooftop echoes mapped. We still need the name of the mast.

lines.speaker: TEAL
lines.text: TEAL (tape): He'll be where he can hear himself. The parliament mast.
lines.spoken: He'll be where he can hear himself. The parliament mast.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Triangulating. He's above the parliament transmitter.
lines.spoken: Triangulating. He's above the parliament transmitter.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Fix is closing. Stay in the volume.
lines.spoken: Fix is closing. Stay in the volume.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Loyalists marked a corridor. Follow two lights into the city.
lines.spoken: Loyalists marked a corridor. Follow two lights into the city.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Loyalists see your lights. Follow the last city beacon.
lines.spoken: Loyalists see your lights. Follow the last city beacon.

lines.speaker: MARINE
lines.text: MARINE: Secure the quay while witnesses board. Cover the marked site.
lines.spoken: Secure the quay while witnesses board. Cover the marked site.

lines.speaker: MARINE
lines.text: MARINE: Witnesses boarding. Quay remains secure.
lines.spoken: Witnesses boarding. Quay remains secure.

lines.speaker: MARINE
lines.text: MARINE: Witnesses aboard. Keep us covered until parliament is in sight.
lines.spoken: Witnesses aboard. Keep us covered until parliament is in sight.

lines.speaker: MARINE
lines.text: MARINE: Parliament in sight. Witnesses still aboard.
lines.spoken: Parliament in sight. Witnesses still aboard.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: His wingmen first. Then him.
lines.spoken: His wingmen first. Then him.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: His relay is still broadcasting. Cut it.
lines.spoken: His relay is still broadcasting. Cut it.

lines.speaker: RUSK
lines.text: RUSK: You cut one relay. Every loyal pilot still hears me. On me, now.
lines.spoken: You cut one relay. Every loyal pilot still hears me. On me, now.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: His last escort pair is forming on him. Clear them.
lines.spoken: His last escort pair is forming on him. Clear them.

lines.speaker: MARINE
lines.text: MARINE: Mark the clear road below him. We need Rusk alive to answer.
lines.spoken: Mark the clear road below him. We need Rusk alive to answer.

lines.speaker: MARINE
lines.text: MARINE: Clear road marked. We are ready to take him into custody.
lines.spoken: Clear road marked. We are ready to take him into custody.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: That's his jet. Teal's voice on his tapes. Bring him down.
lines.spoken: That's his jet. Teal's voice on his tapes. Bring him down.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Rusk is down. Follow three lights to Teal's broadcast line.
lines.spoken: Rusk is down. Follow three lights to Teal's broadcast line.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: One more light. Above it, the whole coast can hear you.
lines.spoken: One more light. Above it, the whole coast can hear you.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: You're on every frequency. Say it your way.
lines.spoken: You're on every frequency. Say it your way.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Last of his diehards. Keep them off the signal.
lines.spoken: Last of his diehards. Keep them off the signal.

lines.speaker: HARBOR
lines.text: HARBOR: Loyalist pilots answering. Every harbor.
lines.spoken: Loyalist pilots answering. Every harbor.

lines.speaker: RUSK
lines.text: RUSK: Every relay says I am the law. Yours is a child's radio. Wing!
lines.spoken: Every relay says I am the law. Yours is a child's radio. Wing!

lines.speaker: RUSK
lines.text: RUSK: Teal obeyed until the one order that mattered. Wing, finish him.
lines.spoken: Teal obeyed until the one order that mattered. Wing, finish him.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: Rusk is turning back in. Here he comes.
lines.spoken: Rusk is turning back in. Here he comes.

lines.speaker: RUSK
lines.text: RUSK: Then hear it from me. Head on.
lines.spoken: Then hear it from me. Head on.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: AIR MARSHAL RUSK pulled back to call his wing. 2 inbound.
lines.spoken: Rusk pulled back to call his wing. Two inbound.

lines.speaker: SERA
lines.text: SERA: AIR MARSHAL RUSK pulled back to call his wing. 3 inbound.
lines.spoken: Rusk pulled back to call his wing. Three inbound.
